03 • Qualification & Pay

Qualification-wise Salary & Wage Guide

These are broad indicative ranges for planning only. They are not official company wage sheets. Actual pay can change by employer, contractor, role, experience, shift, OT, incentives, attendance and benefits.

8th / 10th

Helper, housekeeping, basic support, selected production roles. Indicative: ₹12k–₹22k+.

12th

Production, line support, warehouse and selected office/support roles. Indicative: ₹13k–₹25k+.

ITI

Electrician, fitter, welder, machinist, HVAC, maintenance, technician. Indicative: ₹15k–₹35k+.

Diploma

Technician, quality, production, maintenance, junior engineering. Indicative: ₹18k–₹40k+.

B.Tech / B.E.

Engineering, quality, production, R&D, maintenance and staff roles. Indicative: ₹20k–₹60k+.

Experienced

Senior operator, technician, engineer, supervisor and specialist roles can exceed the above depending on profile.

OT

Overtime is employer/shift/policy dependent. Never assume a fixed OT amount without written confirmation.

Benefits

PF, ESI, canteen, transport, bonus or incentives depend on employer and employment type.

Important: “Salary + OT” should be displayed only when the source provides it. Otherwise the page will show “Not publicly confirmed” instead of guessing.
04 • Safety

Job Safety & Fraud Reporting

Stay Alert. Stay Safe.

Never pay money to an individual for a job offer, interview, registration, document verification or joining unless the requirement has been independently confirmed.

  • Do not share OTP, PIN, password or banking credentials.
  • Be careful with “registration fee”, “security deposit” or “guaranteed job” requests.
  • Verify the company, role, location and contact before travelling for an interview.
  • A company profile on this website does not mean that the company is currently hiring.
Our approach: If you report a suspicious vacancy, our team will review the information. We may request evidence or clarification. A report does not automatically prove fraud, and we will avoid publishing unverified accusations.
